text:
lee: Heads-up: I'm opening a tiny PR to harmonize our docs voice for "errors/fallbacks" and to rename SDK snippet params to match API fields. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/613

anya: Nice. Can you call out exactly which phrasing will be canonical? Want a one-liner we can copy into the style guide.

lee: Sure. Proposal: use conversational, active sentences. Examples: 'We're temporarily routing to a slower model.' and for failures 'We're unable to complete this request right now.' Avoid telegraphic fragments.

michael: Love the approach. Small ask: keep example responses neutral (no marketing tone) and short so they display cleanly in code examples/cards.

lee: Agreed — examples limited to one sentence each. Also standardizing param name: change all `model_name` occurrences in snippets to `model_handle` (server API canonical).

tess: How will we show SDK differences? Our JS and Python clients currently use different arg styles.

lee: Plan: canonical docs use API shape (`model_handle`). Add a small "SDK mapping" callout showing the SDK param and the API field. Example: 

`API: model_handle = "redwood/fast-chat-v1"`

`JS: client.generate({ modelName: "redwood/fast-chat-v1", input: ... }) // maps to model_handle`

`Python: client.generate(model_handle="redwood/fast-chat-v1", input="...")`

michael: Can we show both forms using the same call style where feasible? i.e., object-style for both or function-arg style for both, to reduce cognitive load.

lee: Good call. I'll align the examples to use object-style calls across languages where the SDK supports it.

dev-bot: PR 613 created by lee, requested reviewers: @anya, @michael. CI checks queued. :gear:

anya: One more thing: glossary entry for "model handle" please. Short def + example string and link to models catalog. Also add an alias note for older docs that used `model_name`.

oliver: I can run a quick grep across the repo to find remaining `model_name` snippets and open follow-ups if needed. Suggestion: include a `sed` snippet in the PR to demonstrate automated edits.

lee: Perfect. I'll add a migration section with a `sed` one-liner and a short checklist for maintainers.

michael: Nits for voice copy: prefer "We're" instead of "We are" when space is tight, but keep consistency in formal pages. Add a short rule in style guide about contractions.

tess: Also add a note about keeping example outputs deterministic (no randomized placeholder text) so tests don't flake.

dev-bot: CI passed for PR 613 :white_check_mark:.

anya: Reviewing now. If I don't find blocking issues I'll approve and merge post-merge checklist to follow.

lee: Thanks all — will wait for review then merge and announce in #docs-updates. :tada:
